tools.name: reply
tools.description: Reply on Discord. Pass chat_id from the inbound message. Optionally pass reply_to (message_id) for threading, and files (absolute paths) to attach images or other files.

reply_to.description: Message ID to thread under. Use message_id from the inbound <channel> block, or an id from fetch_messages.

files.description: Absolute file paths to attach (images, logs, etc). Max 10 files, 25MB each.
